description: Jeans, sneakers and other casual attire will not only be allowed but recommended for national civil service job interviews in Korea, replacing the traditional expectation that applicants wear suits. The Ministry of Personnel Management issued detailed guidelines on interview attire on Friday, accompanied by example images. The new guidelines will take effect in October. title: Korea approves jeans for civil service job interviews

description: The Korean War ended with a cease-fire in 1953, but the scale and ferocity of the fighting remain evident in the remains of fallen soldiers and wartime relics found across South Korea. The Army's 2nd Armored Brigade, together with the Ministry of National Defense's Agency for Killed in Action Recovery and Identification, began excavating war remains at Hill 367 in Paju, Gyeonggi Province, on Thursday. title: Battle ended, remains await recovery over 70 years later

description: KATHMANDU -- South Korea will closely consult with Nepal on the resumption of search and rescue operations in the country, the chief of Seoul's second contingent of its disaster relief team sent to Kathmandu said Saturday. title: S. Korea to consult with Nepal on resumption of search, rescue efforts: Seoul official

description: Can a beauty pageant title be considered any less authentic if the winner’s appearance has been surgically enhanced? The question emerged after earlier images of this year’s Miss Korea, Woo Seo-yoon, began circulating online following her crowning at the 70th Miss Korea pageant on Aug. 22. The images prompted comparisons with her current appearance and speculation about what, if anything, she may have done to change her looks. title: Beauty can be made. Yet ‘natural beauty’ still matters in Korea

description: Four days off, cooler air and a calendar crowded with autumn festivals are pulling Korean travelers closer to home this Chuseok. description: South Korea will ban neckties and dress shoes at interviews for central government positions from October, in a move to create a more comfortable atmosphere and encourage applicants to wear casual but neat outfits. The Ministry of Personnel Management said Thursday that it had issued guidelines recommending comfortable attire that does not interfere with applicants' ability to demonstrate their skills. title: Ties, dress shoes banned for relaxed gov't job interviews in Korea. Will it work?

description: The first South Korean container ship to sail through the Arctic shipping route reached a port in the United Kingdom on Saturday, marking the halfway point of its voyage to assess the potential of the long-closed route linking the eastern and western ends of the Eurasian continent. According to the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, the Panstar Acro entered the port of Felixstowe in the UK at around 5 a.m., 21 days after departing Busan on Aug. 22. title: S. Korean ship reaches UK halfway through Arctic voyage

description: A South Korean court has overturned the denial of refugee status for an Iranian Christian after a six-year legal battle, finding that people who convert from Islam to Christianity could face persecution in Iran. According to local media reports Saturday, Seoul Administrative Court Judge Cho Dae-hyeon upheld the plaintiff’s claim seeking to overturn the Seoul Immigration Office’s decision to deny refugee status. title: S. Korean court sides with Iranian Christian refugee applicant

description: South Korea’s presidential National Security Office held an emergency security meeting Saturday with relevant agencies, including the Ministry of National Defense and the Joint Chiefs of Staff, after North Korea fired multiple short-range ballistic missiles from near Wonsan, Gangwon Province, toward the East Sea.
